# Sangam Thapa

> Satellite Systems & On-Board Computer (OBC) Lead, Machine Learning Engineer (Edge AI & Computer Vision, NLP), and Embedded Systems & PCB Design Specialist.

- **Website:** https://thapasangam.com.np
- **Location:** Bhaktapur, Nepal

---

## Affiliations & Current Roles

- **On-Board Computer (OBC) Lead & Research Fellow** at **Antarikchya Pratisthan Nepal (Nepal Space Foundation)**:
  - Leading avionics and flight software design for **Slippers2Sat** — Nepal's first middle school CubeSat mission.
  - Architected **CubeOS**, a modular, PX4 Autopilot-inspired CubeSat flight software system built on NuttX RTOS for STM32F4/H7 and STM32WL microcontrollers (presented at the 75th International Astronautical Congress, IAC 2024, Milan).
  - Deployed quantized Edge AI / TinyML U-Net neural networks on STM32H7 for real-time on-orbit image segmentation.
- **Software & Backend Telemetry Engineer** at **Access System Nepal**:
  - Architecting distributed LoRaWAN telemetry data ingestion pipelines, low-power STM32WL sensor nodes, and real-time backend alerting services.

---

## Core Technical Competencies

- **Space Systems & Flight Software:** CubeSat On-Board Computers (OBC), CubeOS, NuttX RTOS, PX4 Autopilot, ROS 2, Gazebo SITL, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) Simulation, Satellite Telemetry.
- **Embedded Hardware & PCB Design:** Multi-layer PCB Design, STM32F4, STM32H7, STM32WL, Sensor Interfacing (SPI/I2C/UART/CAN), Low-Power RF & LoRaWAN, Fusion 360 CAD.
- **Machine Learning & Edge AI:** PyTorch, TensorFlow, YOLOv12S, YOLOv8, DETR, Faster R-CNN, TinyML, U-Net, Computer Vision (2D/3D Perception).
- **Natural Language Processing (NLP):** Transformer architectures, Sequence-to-Sequence models, Byakaran grammatical error correction (Prasta Nepali).
- **Backend & Cloud Infrastructure:** REST APIs, Spring Boot, AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, Docker, Telemetry Data Pipelines.
- **Programming Languages:** Python, C++, C, MATLAB, Java, Bash, C#, SQL.
